name: Stunning Mist
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level bloodrager 3, magus 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, unchained summoner 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a thunderstone)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect cloud spreads in 20-ft. radius, 20 ft. high
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates; see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Stunning mist creates a bank of fog like that created by fog cloud, except that the vapors resonate in a way that stuns those within. Living creatures in the cloud become stunned. This condition lasts as long as the creature is in the cloud and for 1d4+1 rounds after it leaves. (Roll separately for each stunned character.) A creature gets a new save at the beginning of each of their turns to become un-stunned. Any creature that succeeds on its save but remains in the cloud must continue to save each round on your turn. Stunning mist can be made permanent with a permanency spell. A permanent stunning mist dispersed by wind reforms in 10 minutes.
